info.title: GDS Preview API
info.description: Creates live preview deployments of React apps built with GDS design systems (Gofore GDS or GDS-VERO). Send React component code, a designSystem id, and receive a unique public preview URL.

post.description: Receives React/TSX code for App.tsx (and optional extra component files), wraps it in a Vite + GDS template for the selected design system, and deploys it to Vercel. Always returns HTTP 200 except for auth failures (401). Check the ok field in the response body.

200.description: Action result. When ok is true, deployment started. When ok is false, read error.

designSystem.description: Which design system stack to use. Use "gds" for Gofore GDS (@gdesignsystem/*). Use "gds-vero" for Verohallinto / vero.fi GDS-VERO (@gds-vero/*). Required so multiple Custom GPTs can share this API safely.

appCode.description: The full contents of src/App.tsx. Must export a default React component. GDSProvider is already wrapped in main.tsx — do not add it in App.tsx.

extraFiles.description: Optional additional source files. Keys must start with 'src/' (e.g. 'src/components/Header.tsx'). Values are the full file contents as strings.

title.description: Optional page title for the HTML document. Defaults to 'GDS Preview'.

ok.description: true when deployment started, false when validation or Vercel deploy failed

error.description: Present when ok is false — explain this to the user

previewUrl.description: Primary link to share when ok is true. Opens a building page and redirects to siteUrl when ready.

waitUrl.description: Same as previewUrl when ok is true

siteUrl.description: Direct Vercel preview URL. Only works after build is READY.

previewId.description: Short unique ID for this preview

designSystem.description: The design system used for this deployment

status.description: building when ok is true, error when ok is false
